meta.exam_title: Spare time, charity events and school trips (Class test no. 3)

criteria.intro: Der Prüfling ordnet die Bilder richtig:
bullets: Correct order: A – C – B – D
Pictures E and F do not belong to the story

criteria.short: Beide Fragen zur Geschichte inhaltlich richtig beantwortet
bullets: 2. Because he gave the money back.

sections.titel: 2 Grammar: What do the TTS students love to do in their spare time?

criteria.short: Alle fünf Sätze in korrekter Wortstellung gebildet
criteria.intro: Der Prüfling bildet korrekt, z. B.:
bullets: 1. Luke always plays football at 7 o'clock in Greenwich stadium.
2. Olivia made a new guinea pig model for Pia in the art room yesterday.
3. Jay jumped into a pool after breakfast on the class trip to Wales.
4. Dave usually plays keyboard at music school every afternoon.
5. Holly went shopping in the city some days ago.
schema: 1 Punkt je Satz für korrekte Wortstellung (Subjekt – Verb – Objekt – Ort – Zeit); andere sinnvolle Reihenfolgen ebenfalls anerkennen.

sections.titel: 3 Grammar: Red Nose Day – A great idea!

criteria.short: Alle 16 Verbformen im simple past richtig gebildet

bullets: 1. Were you successful, do you think?
2. How did you get the idea to do this?
3. Where did you do your comedy show?
4. Were you there the whole day?
5. How much money did you get for your charity event?
6. What did you do so that people gave you so much?
schema: 2 Punkte je Frage: 1 Punkt korrektes Fragewort (falls nötig), 1 Punkt korrekte Struktur (mit/ohne **do**, je nachdem ob Vollverb oder **be**).

sections.titel: 5 Grammar: subject and object questions with who and what

schema: 2 Punkte je Frage: 1 Punkt korrekte Unterscheidung Subjekt-/Objektfrage (mit/ohne **did**), 1 Punkt korrekte Wortstellung.

sections.titel: 6 Writing: The charity trip gone wrong

criteria.short: Ausdrucksvermögen/Wortschatz, inkl. der neuen Wörter (unfortunately, although …)
bullets: a varied vocabulary appropriate to the topic (charity, accident, feelings)
correct use of linking words such as 'unfortunately' and 'although' to make the report more elegant

criteria.short: Grammatik korrekt, insbesondere simple past und direct speech
bullets: correct use of the simple past throughout the narrative parts
correct spelling and sentence structure throughout

criteria.short: Bericht vollständig, mindestens 10 Sätze, passende und nachvollziehbare Storyline
bullets: a storyline that fits the picture (coach accident, mud, tractor, police, taxi, etc.)
Luke's and the other children's feelings
an interesting, coherent ending to the story
